annotations.title: One call before an agent sends money: screens the recipient address against the OFAC sanctions list, inspects it on Base

description: One call before an agent sends money: screens the recipient address against the OFAC sanctions list, inspects it on Base (contract or wallet, owner, proxy, mint/blacklist/fee flags) and, if a payee domain is given, checks its registration and age. Returns a verdict (no_flags_found, review, block) with reasons (address=0x..., domain=example.com). Screening aid, not a compliance determination. Pay per call $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

domain.description: optional: the merchant or payee domain, e.g. example.com

x_payment.description: signed x402 payment (X-PAYMENT header value); omit on the first call to receive the price and payment requirements
